statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
CPT code 93226 (48-hour Holter monitor) was billed
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
A 48-hour Holter monitor is medically necessary to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes
The documented symptoms correlate with the cardiac diagnoses, supporting the clinical need for continuous rhythm monitoring
